parsed.name: 内存持久化存储系统
parsed.description: 一种用于实验数据管理软件的内存型持久化存储组件，用于保存项目数据、数据项属性、对象关系和库设置。它主要用于测试或临时数据管理，不对应独立的物理实验仪器。
parsed.description_en: An in-memory persistent storage component for scientific data-management software, used to hold project data, data item properties, relationships, and library settings. It is mainly intended for testing or temporary data handling rather than a standalone physical laboratory instrument.
